contractObjects.name: Reach Phase 1 observation, calibration and laboratory foundation

experienceIntent.objective: Point at calibration targets using my real hand and understand whether I can act
experienceIntent.visibleOutcome: Detected hand, tracking quality, gesture classification and calibration eligibility remain visibly distinct
experienceIntent.persona: A Creator or Player completing the named human objective
experienceIntent.accessibility: Provide keyboard/touch operation and a meaningful supported alternate experience.

baselineDebt.deficiency: Hand detection can be confused with action eligibility, producing misleading calibration feedback.

experienceIntent.limitation: This campaign defines the required experience and tracks existing debt; it does not implement Spatial Experience Refit.

experience.persona: A Creator, Player or owner exploring local hand interaction with an ordinary webcam
experience.objective: Enable a camera, see honest tracking, calibrate and independently check pointing, practice, recover and return naturally
experience.visibleOutcome: A coherent staged camera and pointing workspace with visible acquisition, distinct recognition stages, safe recovery and independent results
experience.accessibility: Keyboard, touch and ordinary buttons operate setup, pause, retry, deletion, export and return. A disclosed guided demo explains the full flow without a camera.
experience.fallback: Camera failure gives a plain-language explanation, retry and a guided conventional demonstration. All Voyagewright navigation remains conventional.
experience.navigation: Existing device connections link opens Reach; the visible return clears owned camera resources and restores device connections; safe contextual return is accepted.
experience.designTarget: One continuous instrument workspace with a large registered camera stage, restrained brass and sea-green hierarchy, staged target plane, contextual guidance, visible progress and deliberately disclosed diagnostics. Mobile preparation prioritizes the camera and calibration prioritizes the target.

references.reason: Accepted public entry establishes hierarchy and a coherent shell around distinct role destinations.
references.preserve: Visible account access, clear destinations, cinematic composition and a usable reduced-motion equivalent.

references.reason: Accepted constrained gateway keeps the same destinations and account access.
references.preserve: Mobile task hierarchy, readable controls and contextual navigation.

motion.measurement: Visible-control activation to changed rendered readiness or next-stage outcome; software UI feedback only, excluding camera exposure or inference accuracy

continuity.objective: Maintain the existing Voyagewright origin and navigation destination before, during and after local camera/observation/calibration work; no pairing or progression authority moves into Reach.

limitations: D0 and photographic D1 replay do not establish real-person webcam accuracy, field ergonomics or owner acceptance.
Absolute empirical RGB pointing is experimental and must pass held-out validation for the current setup; relative cursor control has distinct setup and claims.
Camera movement can be undetectable. Calibration is session-only and must be repeated after placement, identity or geometry changes.
Phase 2 target selection, Phase 3 manipulation and Crossdeck Air Handoff are not implemented by this laboratory.

journeys.outcome: A person enters naturally, understands tracking, completes nine training and five independent targets, practices, sees detected ineligible hands and safely returns

experience.fallback: Guided Lens preserves the released clue without camera permission; unavailable device purposes remain explained and disabled while Journal and safe return remain available.

motion.measurement: Keyboard activation to the changed visible connection or canonical companion outcome
motion.justification: Bound the isolated browser transition to useful visible feedback within five seconds, including authorized network projection and supported motion; this is no physical-device performance claim.

limitations: Canonical synthetic account/session setup proves authorization and persisted membership; it does not grant owner acceptance, camera/native spatial capability or real-phone proof.

Actual two-context pairing, handoff acknowledgement, revocation and restricted shared-display privacy remain covered by the dedicated browser specification; the single-context capture signs in and registers through the actual product UI.

This focused consumer contract delivers an already published synthetic Creator-authored clue. Creator Studio authoring and publication retain their existing qualification scope; no new authoring or native camera acceptance is claimed.

The existing generic seed owns only a deterministic synthetic account and persisted edition in a guarded nonce database; real sign-in, authorization and device registration establish each capture surface without injected cookies or tab storage.

The guarded persisted fixture represents an already-opened active Voyage. Every primary entry waits for visible Journal tools, and companion return proves the canonical returning Journal and its replay control rather than assuming a first-open dialog in each signed-in context.

The same synthetic canonical account owns its primary email, one verified secondary email and existing-style Player username. Six-contract captures retain all twenty desktop/mobile and normal/reduced contexts while respecting the unchanged six-per-login sign-in guard; no account/session injection or auth bypass is used.
experience.objective: Read and inspect the actual published spatial clue while keeping the same Voyage
experience.visibleOutcome: A released Creator-authored spatial moment opens its canonical Guided Lens, meaningful inspection and a direct return to the same published Voyage
experience.navigation: Open the active Journal, open its released Chronicle Lens, inspect the actual clue, then close Lens and return to the same Journal.
experience.designTarget: Preserve the published clue and readable Guided hierarchy, with truthful camera availability, keyboard inspection and an immediate contextual close/return.

contractObjects.name: Homeport readable Player account recovery after companion access ends

experience.persona: A signed-out Player returning to the canonical account task after a companion connection loses access
experience.objective: Read the Player account entry, use canonical sign-in and recovery, and safely return to the phone connection task
experience.visibleOutcome: Readable Player account instructions and links lead to one canonical account flow and a contextual return to the connection task
experience.accessibility: The parchment entry has readable explanation and recovery links; keyboard focus reaches every account and contextual return action without horizontal overflow.
experience.fallback: The existing canonical account flow remains usable without an identity provider; expired or revoked private companion content is not presented by this anonymous entry.
experience.navigation: Player account entry opens canonical sign-in; Forgot Password and Return to Sign In retain the safe return intent; Return to previous page restores the phone connection task.
experience.designTarget: Preserve the current parchment account ledger and its hierarchy, with material-appropriate ink, explicit account actions and a readable safe return.

references.reason: The accepted narrow task composition uses one visible objective and a clear recovery/return hierarchy.
references.preserve: Readable task-first typography, grouped fields, useful recovery links, intentional narrow-mobile layout.

references.reason: The accepted mobile account ledger keeps fields and recovery actions readable and reachable.
references.preserve: Readable task-first typography, grouped fields, useful recovery links, intentional narrow-mobile layout.
